title: Formal Proof of OEIS A189286 Integrality and 2-adic Divisibility Conjectures
abstract: Complete Lean 4 formal proofs of two conjectures by Zhi-Wei Sun (2011) on OEIS A189286, defined by a(n) = (sum_{k=0}^n C(6k,3k) C(3k,k) C(6(n-k),3(n-k)) C(3(n-k),n-k)) / ((2n-1) C(3n,n)). This combined submission proves two distinct results: (1) an independent, self-contained elementary proof of the previously proved integrality conjecture (conjecture_1; earlier proved in T. Adamczewski, arXiv:2608.11941), via termwise p-adic divisibility using Legendre's formula and a 3-adic lifting argument; and (2) an original proof of Conjecture (ii) (conjecture_3: for every n >= 1, 8 divides a(n) and a(n)/8 is odd iff n is a power of two), via Kummer's theorem, binary submask counting, and a fixed-point-free involution mod 4. As of November 2026, conjecture_3 was listed without proof on OEIS A189286 and marked research open in FormalConjectures/OEIS/189286.lean, though no exhaustive literature search is claimed to rule out other proofs.
